text:
QUOTE: "`mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init` (`memory_buffer_alloc.c:566`) takes a caller-supplied buffer and carves it into blocks with headers. It installs its own calloc/free through `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free`."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the buffer allocator's init installs itself via the setter. It never says this is the only in-tree user, and it also describes the repo's test config as calling the setter. It doesn't name MBEDTLS_MEMORY_BUFFER_ALLOC_C either.
